$ corvex validate --help

--- stdout ---
Validate spins up the configured stack (DB + app + optional Chrome),
then runs an AI agent to test endpoints and UI flows against the spec.

Usage:
  corvex validate <project> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for validate

Global Flags:
      --no-color   Disable color output
  -q, --quiet      Suppress per-task progress; print only failures/errors and the final summary
